pairs.question: Negant claves in sua potestate fuisse. Quis igitur eas habebat?
pairs.derivation: Genuine interrogative (Quis igitur eas habebat?) directly answered. Kept the preceding sentence 'Negant claves in sua potestate fuisse' as verbatim setup so 'eas' (the keys) has a referent. Answer ends at the first full stop ('Aiebant reginam.'); what follows ('Differtur quaestio in speciem...') resumes the narrative and does not answer. The other ?-lines in the text (quid opus est oratione?, Coetera quis nescit?, Quid enim aliud faceret?, Sed quis auderet... arguere?) are rhetorical with no genuine direct answer and were dropped.
